about.title: About Me
about.body:
I'm a Full Stack Developer specializing in building modern, accessible, and scalable solutions using React, Node.js, TypeScript, and DevOps. I have delivered results in accessibility, fintech, automations, and internal systems projects for companies and clients.

My experience covers complex integrations, REST APIs, front-end and back-end architecture, automated testing, and continuous deployment. Highlights include EcoVoz (digital accessibility) and Control Finance (personal fintech).

I believe technology should create real impact and make life easier. My personal journey has strengthened my empathy, resilience, and focus on solving real problems—values I bring to every project.
